01 · How it works

Every task runs one loop: read, check, bind.

The skills teach an agent to look before it writes, prove the markup is valid before it saves, and pull real values instead of pasting them.

Read · Wesper

Read the site

Wesper collects what the site accepts: registered blocks, theme tokens and bindable fields. The agent writes nothing until it has this.

npx wesper collect --wp-path ./public --out site.context.json→ site.context.json
Check · Block Runner

Check the markup

Block Runner assembles the agent's intent into block markup and validates it with the editor's own parser, before anything is saved.

npx block-runner validate page.html --strict --json --context site.context.json→ exit 0, valid markup
Bind · voyager/site-data

Bind real data

The pack binds attributes to Site Data and post meta. The bind ability accepts only the arguments its catalog lists.

{"source":"voyager/site-data","args":{"key":"phone_link"}}→ the page shows the real number
Then it proves it. get-post-blocks reports every binding as resolved or fell_back, with the reason, so the agent checks the value instead of assuming it.

03 · Install

Give it to your agent.

Install the plugin on the site and the skills in the agent's harness. Then ask for a page.

Install

Pick the route that matches how you ship plugins.

$ npx skills add voyager-marketing/voyager-open-blocks
$ wp plugin install voyager-open-blocks.zip --activate
$ composer require voyager-marketing/voyager-open-blocks

Or skip installing: open the pack in Playground with demo content.

Then ask for a page

One prompt the skills are written for.

Add the voyager-open/cta-band pattern to the end of the Services page. Rewrite the heading and the line of copy for that page, keep the click-to-call button bound to voyager/site-data phone_link, and validate the page with Block Runner before saving.

Start the agent at skills/voyager-open-blocks/SKILL.md.

Try the pack before you install it.

Playground loads every block and pattern with demo content, in your browser.
